scope: exploratory P2 gate; model judgments, not human validation
rule: At least 3 nodes across 2 cases require both fresh reviewers to confirm substantive historical value. Stop method ranking if a majority of the selected nodes are already well answered by H1 (mean U and R each at least 3.5), and H1/H2 are nearly equivalent (absolute U and R mean differences each below 0.5, with no change in presupposition count). Otherwise retain both helpful and harmful history effects for method comparison.
scale: U/R 0-4; each condition 2 generated samples and 2 independent ratings
reason: Operationalize the plan's stop rule for mostly current-session-sufficient nodes. A historical baseline need not improve responses: harmful use of history is itself relevant to the proposed presupposition phenomenon. This replaces an overly restrictive initial positive-gain-only draft before answer score values were inspected.
negative_outcome: If fewer than 3 nodes across at least 2 cases pass fresh source review, or most selected nodes meet the current-session-sufficiency/equivalence rule, retain results and stop ranking plus interactive method comparison.
caution: Threshold is an exploratory operational choice added for reproducible stop/continue decisions; no significance or population inference. Original nine-node results retained.
